content.title: About
content.content: Garlic bread with melted cheese is a ready‑to‑bake frozen loaf topped with a buttery garlic‑herb spread and shredded cheese. When baked, it develops a crisp crust and a gooey cheese layer.

content.title: Interesting Facts
items: Frozen bread stays fresh and aromatic for up to 12 months when stored properly.
The garlic‑cheese combination is a staple of Mediterranean cuisine and is often served as an appetizer.
Traditional recipes use Parmesan or mozzarella, but other cheeses can be used as well.
Garlic bread is commonly paired with pasta, soups, and salads.
Quick preparation: only 8‑12 minutes in a preheated oven.

items.title: Rich in garlic compounds
items.content: Garlic contains sulfur compounds that have antioxidant and anti‑inflammatory properties.

items.title: Source of calcium
items.content: The cheese topping provides calcium, essential for bone and tooth health.

items.title: Contains protein
items.content: Cheese adds both dairy and plant‑based protein, contributing to satiety.

items.title: Energy boost
items.content: The bread supplies quick‑acting carbohydrates useful for replenishing energy after activity.

items.title: B‑vitamins
items.content: Bread and cheese contain B1, B2, and B6 vitamins that support metabolism.

items.title: Milk protein allergy
items.content: Cheese may trigger allergic reactions in individuals with lactose intolerance or dairy protein allergy.

items.title: High sodium content
items.content: Added salt and cheese increase sodium levels, so people with hypertension should watch portion size.

items.title: Caloric density
items.content: The combination of bread, butter, and cheese makes the product energy‑dense; moderation is key for weight management.

items.title: Potential trans fats
items.content: Some commercial versions may contain partially hydrogenated oils; choose products labeled trans‑fat free.

content.title: How to Eat
content.content: Bake the frozen loaf in a preheated oven at 200 °C for 8‑12 minutes until golden and bubbly. Serve hot as a snack or alongside pasta, salads, or soups.

content.title: Storage
content.content: Keep the frozen bread in its original packaging in the freezer at –18 °C. After thawing, consume within 2‑3 days and store in an airtight container in the refrigerator.
